scoring_justification: Clean surface structural parameters (d spacing, Al–O bond length) and energetic quantities (relaxation energy, LUMO destabilization) are recomputed from the agent's raw XYZ and JSON artifacts. The C–O bond length is recomputed from the CO-adsorbed geometry. Adsorption enthalpy and frequency are compared against paper-reported values, supported by the structural cross-check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Clean surface structural and energetic reference values, and CO adsorption reference values
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (clean surface: Al_I displacement, d spacing, Al_I–O_I bond length, relaxation energy, LUMO shift) and Table 2 (adsorption enthalpy, C–O bond length, C–O stretching frequency for C-down geometry)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Gold values copied directly from the paper's reported numbers; tolerances chosen to allow for toolchain spread while ensuring only real computations hit the target.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are traceable to explicit entries in the source paper's tables; not invented.

schema.description: XYZ format with atom symbols and coordinates. The checker will parse lines and compute structural parameters.

outputs.description: Relaxed geometry of the clean Al8O12 cluster. Used to verify surface relaxation displacements and bond lengths.
Energy values from single-point calculations. The checker recomputes relaxation energy and LUMO destabilization.

schema.description: XYZ format of CO-adsorbed cluster. Used to verify the C-O bond length and geometry.

outputs.description: Optimized geometry of CO adsorbed C-down on the cluster.
Reported adsorption properties: enthalpy, bond length, and vibrational frequency. Checker compares these to reference values.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute structural parameters (displacements, d spacing, bond lengths) from the XYZ geometry files using known bulk reference positions. Energies and LUMO shift are recomputed from clean_energies.json. Adsorption properties are compared against reference values with appropriate tolerances.
